name: Modules and classes
description: Programs in several files: modules and imports, local libraries, managed and direct modules, extension methods, and then classes and methods with constructors, visibility and inheritance. The standard library of the language is also written as modules from this level on.

features.name: Library reference
features.summary: Generated by eve --doc for every standard module.

features.name: Strings, math, collections and type conversions
features.summary: split, join, format, parse, floor, round, sort, search.

features.name: Classes
features.summary: Attributes, constructors, new, methods with @self, inheritance, visibility; a class hosts only methods and only a method has @self.

features.name: Typed exceptions
features.summary: Error classes with fields, recover by type, exit-code mapping.

features.name: Static checks
features.summary: Name resolution, arity, visibility and type errors before the run (exit 65).

features.name: Managed and direct modules
features.summary: managed module / direct module (default), per-member thread safety proved by the compiler, a concurrent aspect calls only safe members.

features.name: External routines and errors of modules
features.summary: An external routine of a module whose name is that of a native module (os, fs, crypto,...) is bound to the native of the same name; an error raised in a module names the file of the module and the...

features.name: Library specification
features.summary: Built-ins and standard modules as signatures.

features.name: Modules and imports
features.summary: module, from … use (…), aliases, m(), (), singletons, initialize/recover/finalize, export, private members, circular imports, $err_module.

features.name: Extension methods
features.summary: method name(@self: Class) outside the class.

features.name: Projects and search paths
features.summary: Project root $EVE_HOME, asp/, lib/, data/, web/ (templates), out/, $EVE_LIB, $EVE_LIB_PATH.

features.name: REPL
features.summary: Prompt, file completion, commands check, execute, help, quit; 2026-10-13: the full-screen interface at a terminal (upper part with scrollback, command line between two rules, status bar with Ready /...

features.name: Interactive interpreter
features.summary: Evaluate Eve statements and expressions typed at the prompt, keep the session scope.

features.name: Library loader and `external` bindings
features.summary: Load .eve library modules and bind external declarations to Zig.
